name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.state_domains
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool), 0 < N → p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.StateOK N p
guidance: Unfold selected/available wrappers and StateOK. Every selected/available positive position is i+1 with i<N-1, hence below positive N. Zero is inserted into both selected sets and cannot occur in available sets. Disjointness follows from offset+i<p.length versus p.length<=offset+i; Nat arithmetic and image membership suffice. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.
